answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 44262 Country: India Title: Charity Question: Is it permissible for the charitable organization to accept the money that it knows the donor received through interest earnings? Answer ID: 44262 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 387/305/B=1434) If someone owns interest money more than halal income or all his income is haram and it is known with surety then it is not lawful to accept such amount. But if interest income is less and halal is more, then it is lawful to accept his money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
